leads.claim: A citizen collected fused sand from a site where a fire occurred and submitted it to a physics laboratory for analysis.
leads.why: The document describes the physical collection and laboratory submission of material, though it is likely mundane debris.
leads.material_description: Fused sand, some of which was radioactive.
leads.quote: SCOOPED UP A THREE INCH AREA OF FUSED SAND INTO A CAN AND TOOK THIS TO THE PHYSICS LAB.

leads.claim: Individuals claimed to possess fragments of a flying disc recovered from Maury Island.
leads.why: The document details a specific claim of material recovery, custody by military officers, and a subsequent investigation into the veracity of the claim.
leads.quote: THEY OBTAINED SOME OF THE DISC FRAGMENTS.

doc_verdict: The document contains reports of individuals claiming to possess physical material, but these claims are explicitly identified within the text as hoaxes or mundane substances.
